## 逐条评估

### N1 [DEFF range] — 方案可行，但有隐患需预处理
✅ "Bootstrap-primary, DEFF-secondary" 的叙事重构路径正确——bootstrap 不依赖 DEFF 方法论假设，对 reviewer 更直观。
⚠️ **隐患**：当前 "13.5-29.2%" 出现在 abstract / intro / experiments / discussion / conclusion / limitations 共 6 处。如果 bootstrap CI [26.7%, 53.2%] 成为 primary evidence，reviewer 会问："bootstrap 排除了 13.5%，为什么你的 headline 还用它？" 
**建议**：保留 13.5-29.2% 作为 headline range（它是 conservative DEFF-corrected range），但在 §4.2 的论证流程中 lead with bootstrap → bootstrap 排除 13.5% → 解释 weighted-mean over-correction → 即使在 13.5% 下结论仍成立。不要把 bootstrap CI 当 headline 替换品（那会改 6 处且引入新的过宽问题——53.2% 的上界更难 defend），而是当 evidence 来支撑 "29.2% 比 13.5% 更可信"。
✅ 不做新实验——LOFO 已覆盖。正确。

### N2 [Graded injection] — 方案基本充分，但漏了一个已有证据
✅ Analytical bound 路径对 DDL-1 场景合理。Semi-synthetic 是 validation tool，不是 core claim。
⚠️ **遗漏**：论文的 dose-response 已包含 p ∈ {0.0, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0}（method.tex:46），这本身就是 graded exploitation rate。ΔTPR 在 p=0.3 时已有数据点（Figure 2）。R19 reviewer 要的 "graded probability shift" 可能就是这个——应先检查 reviewer 的具体措辞。如果是要 item-level heterogeneous injection（不同 item 不同 p），difficulty-dependent 已部分覆盖。
**建议**：方案 (b)-(d) 之前加一步——在 §4.5 更显式地指出 "the dose-response already varies p from 0.3 to 1.0; difficulty-dependent injection further introduces item-level heterogeneity"。如果这已经回答了 reviewer 的问题，analytical bound 就不需要了。
✅ "Reference-case detection power calibration" 而非 "real-world power estimate" 的 framing 正确。

### N3 [Impact/bias distinction] — 方案完全正确，但需注意 impact tradeoff

**Title:** Temporal Score Incomparability in LLM Benchmarks: A Large-Scale Psychometric Audit of 5,227 Models

**Abstract:** LLM benchmark scores are compared across model generations, yet whether individual items measure the same construct over time is rarely tested. We apply differential item functioning (DIF) analysis from educational measurement to six METABENCH benchmarks (5,227 models), validated through a semi-synthetic injection framework with cross-subject matching. Between 2023 and 2024 model cohorts, 17.9--31.3% of items exhibit large temporal DIF (29.2% for MMLU after non-independence correction, cluster bootstrap 95% CI: [26.7%, 53.2%]; ≥22× random baseline). Web-overlap labels (a proxy for training-set contamination) are near-independent of DIF flags: global exposure and differential functioning are complementary diagnostic dimensions. Temporal DIF does not threaten aggregate rankings (ρ ≈ 0.997) but reveals structured item-level change---base and instruct models exhibit opposite DIF patterns (χ² = 562.7), evidence that DIF captures capability shifts beyond contamination---and shifts DIF-corrected scores by +2.12 pp on average. We propose a three-step audit protocol (Monitor/Triage/Correct) with empirically grounded thresholds for benchmark maintainers. LLM benchmarks need psychometric monitoring, not just score reporting.
